key: 13 rating columns + Class + Type of Travel + Customer Type
reading: A pure group with >=2 rows means two distinct passengers share the exact same 16 rating/categorical profile and nevertheless received the same label. The share of rows in pure groups, and the leave-one-out group-mean AUC, measure how much of the label is a function of the discrete profile alone. The source population is almost deterministic there; the synthetic population is not, which is the mechanism behind the two CV ceilings.
